# Legally embattled AI music startup Suno raises at $2.45B valuation on $200M revenue (TechCrunch)

By Julie Bort. Nov 19, 2025.

## Key findings
- **Suno** raised a **$250M Series C** at a **$2.45B post-money valuation**.
- Led by **Menlo Ventures**; participation from **Nvidia's venture arm NVentures, Hallwood Media, Lightspeed, and Matrix**.
- **$200M annual revenue** (Suno told WSJ).
- Prior round: **$125M Series B (May 2024)**, led by Lightspeed, Nat Friedman, Daniel Gross, Matrix, Founder Collective, at an estimated **$500M valuation**.
- Suno is being sued by Sony, UMG, and Warner over training on copyrighted material.

## Assessment
- `authoritative: yes` — TechCrunch, top-tier tech/business outlet.
- Corroborates 150 (exact figures + investor list incl. Hallwood Media) and adds prior-round history ($125M Series B, $500M) + $200M revenue. Supports Q2 funding ranking. Scope: general AI music platform, not hip-hop-specific.
